name: devx-repo-check

tools.name: check_command
tools.description: Free, offline. Call BEFORE running a shell/PowerShell command from a README, issue, website or chat: flags download-and-execute (iwr|iex, curl|sh from unknown hosts), encoded PowerShell, LOLBins, disabling antivirus, known malware domains.

tools.name: check_local_repo
tools.description: Free, offline. Scan a cloned repo directory (README, package.json install scripts and typosquatted deps, install.sh, setup.py, .vscode/tasks.json autorun, Makefile) BEFORE running npm install or its setup steps.

tools.name: check_repo
tools.description: Free. Fetch a public GitHub repo's README and scan its install steps BEFORE cloning or following them. Paid full check (0.005 USDC, x402) adds install scripts, deps and fake-star signals.

instructions: Before following a repo's install steps or running a copied shell command, check it here. Read-only; never executes code.
